## `set_global_default_analyst`

*Available in [R](#set_global_default_analyst-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to set the default analyst at the user level and
    if possible changes the default analyst in the template for new projects.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_global_default_analyst(analyst_name, update_template = FALSE)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `analyst_name` - A string containing the analyst name
    - `update_template` - Bool whether or not to update analyst in the project template.

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A message stating the name has been changed.
